page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, 32.0 GB of system memory providing 8.0 GB per core, and a bundled 959 GB local SSD. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline of 1 Gbps, and the instance runs on a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.i2.xlarge delivers modest processing and memory capabilities. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests place the instance in the bottom 25% of performance. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large-block read-only operations registering at 19.71 GB/sec, which is categorized in the bottom 10%. Database operations and static web serving throughput also fall into the lower performance tiers, with Passmark database operations scoring 1083.99 and web serving throughput reaching 2.4 GB/sec.

While CPU and memory performance are relatively weak compared to modern standards, the server offers a high local storage capacity of 959 GB SSD bundled directly with 32 GB of RAM. This configuration provides a qualitative advantage in resource density for storage-heavy workloads that do not require high-speed compute. The instance is suited for legacy database hosting, basic caching layers, local file processing, and general-purpose workloads requiring significant local storage capacity rather than high-throughput compute or memory bandwidth.
